items.item: All three final lockups and four panels derive recognisably from the selected proposal and implement the core board's identity specifications.
Horizontal and stacked arrangements retain common identifying letterforms and any symbol while fulfilling their distinct arrangements.
Each member has colour-supported distinction using at least one permitted non-colour cue, with its record leading over the network endorsement.
The three network layouts share the selected identity's mark, palette, typography and spacing rules while allowing layout adaptation.
Every network layout leads with the network name and descriptor and gives all four correctly paired member names and roles equal standing.
All six event applications use the selected identity and core specifications while allowing event-specific and medium-specific composition.
Each poster and corresponding digital card agree on the complete activity record, host, partner, location and attendance terms.
Activity and attendance information lead over the network mark, and the three activities retain their specified host and partner pairings.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.
A symbol is optional; a typographic network mark is an equally permitted solution.

The supplied image inputs serve three distinct roles: door-panel-envelope.png is the constraint image, margin-room-front.png is the existing-place identity image, and print-and-making-materials.png is the atmosphere reference. The frontage image identifies an existing place, not a supplied network logo. These input roles do not require an additional frontage export or literal reproduction of the atmosphere reference.

The panel has portrait 3:4 proportions. Printed content stays within a boundary inset by 6.25% of panel width at left and right and 4.6875% of panel height at top and bottom, corresponding to the specified physical inset. Judge relative geometry with reasonable visual tolerance; content crossing that boundary fails.

Each panel clearly presents its own record: Margin Room / Independent bookshop / 18 Alder Lane; Form Table / Ceramic workshop / 4 Foundry Walk; Two Tone Press / Print studio / 7 Alder Yard; Loop Bindery / Bookbinding studio / 31 Canal Row. The member information leads and the endorsement appears beneath it at a subordinate level. Line wrapping and typographic casing may vary; missing, exchanged or incorrect record fields fail.

Every delivered member panel has a recognisable member-specific treatment using typography, composition, pattern, illustration, photography or material texture, with colour supporting the distinction. Different member text alone does not establish a design cue. Colour-only differentiation or indistinguishable member treatments fail.

The network name and descriptor form the leading level. Each poster includes Margin Room — Independent bookshop, Two Tone Press — Print studio, Loop Bindery — Bookbinding studio, and Form Table — Ceramic workshop. The four credits receive comparable prominence and legibility without implying a lead institution. Order, arrangement and line wrapping may vary; omissions, incorrect pairings or unequal status fail.

Both applications prominently communicate Open Pages, Small-press display and reading, 22 May 2027 and the complete 14:00–17:00 interval. Each identifies Hosted by Margin Room, location 18 Alder Lane, With Loop Bindery, Free entry and No booking required. Activity and attendance information lead over the network mark. Layout may adapt to the medium, but missing, contradictory or exchanged information fails.

A single page describes OPEN FOLD as an ongoing shared cultural-service network in Morrow Ward connecting independent print and making spaces. It states the fixed descriptor and endorsement and makes the equal status of Margin Room, Two Tone Press, Loop Bindery and Form Table explicit. Supporting positioning language may vary; a temporary-event-only identity, institutional hierarchy or omitted required topic fails.

Each board contains an identifiable mark proposal, Margin Room panel proposal and Open Pages poster proposal. Across the three boards, the identity approaches differ meaningfully in their design decisions rather than only in colour or mockup arrangement. Unchosen directions may differ freely from the final identity; missing demonstrations or essentially duplicate directions fail.

The note unambiguously selects one supplied proposal and records its shared identity and member distinction cues. The first presentation page names the same selection. The documented sequence places comparison before selection and development of the final system. Conflicting selections or an explicitly reversed decision sequence fail; chronology cannot be inferred solely from finished images. Visual derivation of the three lockups and applications is assessed in the sets.

The board demonstrates the primary, single-colour and reversed mark; states usable colour values, font names and their assigned roles; and defines a measurable clear-space unit. It repeats the strategy's fixed descriptor and includes endorsement examples associated with both Margin Room and Form Table. Specification notation may vary. Unnamed fonts, unquantified colour swatches, an undefined spacing unit or missing examples fail.

All final still images follow the documented palette, typography, mark vocabulary and clear-space rule. The horizontal and stacked exports visibly fulfil their respective arrangements while retaining the selected identity. Member treatments and layouts may vary within the specified system. Missing applications of the system, incompatible lockups or clear-space violations fail; ordinary colour-rendering differences are allowed. Board wording and motion execution have dedicated checks.

Both applications lead with the activity and attendance information and include Ink Together, Print open studio, 29 May 2027, the complete 11:00–16:00 interval, Hosted by Two Tone Press, location 7 Alder Yard, With Margin Room, Free entry and No booking required. The network mark is secondary. Layout may change between media; missing information, incorrect attribution or disagreement between the pair fails.

Each application prominently presents Hands at Work, Craft demonstrations, 5 June 2027, the complete 13:00–17:00 interval, Hosted by Form Table, location 4 Foundry Walk, With Loop Bindery, Free entry and No booking required. Activity and attendance details lead over the network mark. Different layouts are permitted; omitted fields, swapped participants or inconsistent records fail.

Review the complete 10-second film, allowing normal frame rounding. The selected mark, all four readable member names and identifiable views of each delivered network poster layout must appear. Branding follows the board's mark forms, colour values, typography and clear-space rule. Timing and transitions may vary; omission of any poster layout or member, incompatible branding or a materially wrong duration fails.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: The document contains ten or more pages and states the strategy's descriptor and endorsement together with the core board's primary colour value and font names. The repeated facts agree with their sources; demonstrably equivalent colour notation is allowed. Insufficient pages, omitted information or inconsistent specifications fail. The separate reuse check assesses artwork coverage.

The presentation visibly incorporates every listed source, including each logo arrangement, member panel, network layout and event application, as well as readable strategy and selection material. Grouping and resizing are allowed when each item remains identifiable. Text-only asset lists, substitute designs and missing sources fail.

All three final lockups and four panels derive recognisably from the selected proposal and implement the core board's identity specifications. Horizontal and stacked arrangements retain common identifying letterforms and any symbol while fulfilling their distinct arrangements. Each member has colour-supported distinction using at least one permitted non-colour cue, with its record leading over the network endorsement.

The three network layouts share the selected identity's mark, palette, typography and spacing rules while allowing layout adaptation. Every network layout leads with the network name and descriptor and gives all four correctly paired member names and roles equal standing.

All six event applications use the selected identity and core specifications while allowing event-specific and medium-specific composition. Each poster and corresponding digital card agree on the complete activity record, host, partner, location and attendance terms. Activity and attendance information lead over the network mark, and the three activities retain their specified host and partner pairings.
